headline.line_2: Driven by precision in every detail.

paragraphs: CP Real Estate is the foundation of CP Group, built on decades of trust, discipline and consistent delivery.
From an eight-unit residence in Ashrampara to Hill View Residency, The Universe and CP Greens today, every project has built on the last.

section_5_customer_journey.name: From First Call to Your Keys (The Customer Experience)
section_5_customer_journey.classes: theme-night relative isolate overflow-clip bg-night py-24 lg:py-36
section_5_customer_journey.headline: From first call to your keys.
section_5_customer_journey.subtext: Buying a home has many steps. We walk every one of them with you, so nothing is left to chance and nothing is left to you alone.

steps.name: Enquiry
steps.title: We listen first
steps.text: Tell us what you need, by call, WhatsApp or the website. Our team calls you back within 24 hours.
care: Homes matched to your family and budget

steps.name: Details
steps.title: Everything, upfront
steps.text: Brochures, floor plans, unit areas and RERA details, shared clearly so you can compare with confidence.

steps.name: Site visit
steps.title: See it for yourself
steps.text: A guided visit at a time that suits you, to walk the site, the sample spaces and the neighbourhood.
care: Time with the team who builds it

steps.name: Booking
steps.title: A fair conversation
steps.text: We talk through the unit, the price and the payment plan openly, and put every figure in writing.

steps.name: Agreement
steps.title: Paperwork, explained
steps.text: We prepare the agreement for sale and walk you through each clause before you sign.

steps.name: Home loan
steps.title: Help with your loan
steps.text: We help you gather and prepare the documents your bank needs and stay in touch with them until the loan is sanctioned.

steps.name: Registration
steps.title: Registration, handled
steps.text: We schedule the registration, prepare the papers and guide you through the day itself.

steps.name: Handover
steps.title: Keys, and beyond
steps.text: A walkthrough of your finished home, the keys, and a team that stays a call away after you move in.
